text:
Maria (People Ops): @anika FYI Sanjay's background check flagged an ID mismatch — passport name vs his current profile. He's remote (India) and passport renewal is in progress. Can we do an I-9 workaround?

Anika (HR Partner): Thanks. We'll need a notarized affidavit + the renewal receipt. Legal prefers an e-notary + recorded video attestation for remote hires where local notary access is limited.

Maria (People Ops): Options: 1) local notary + courier of docs, 2) accept digital notarization + short video attestation, 3) temporary hold on laptop/benefits until cleared. Which path do we want?

Anika (HR Partner): Legal OKs e-notary + video if the candidate shows original docs on camera, reads the affidavit, and we capture the session. Please provide candidate instructions and a template.

Maria (People Ops): @sanjay can you share the passport renewal receipt and a clear photo of the passport page? Also what timezone windows work for a 10–15 min video attestation?

Sanjay (New Hire): Morning all — I can do 8:30pm IST (3:00pm UTC). I uploaded the renewal receipt here: https://imgur.com/example (placeholder). Video is fine. Do you need notarization before or after the video?

Kevin (IT-Ops): Heads up — laptop shipment is blocked until we have I-9 verification completed. I can hold the device for 48 hrs. If video attestation happens tonight, we can ship tomorrow morning. @maria please confirm shipping address so I can queue it.

Maria (People Ops): Sanjay — address noted. Please fill this exception form: https://forms.redwood.com/i9-exception and select "remote-notary". Quick copy of the attestation script for the video: 

```
I, [Full Name], hereby attest that the passport shown on camera and the attached renewal receipt are authentic and belong to me. I consent to Redwood Inference recording this verification for onboarding records.
```

Anika (HR Partner): I'll add a row to the Onboard Exceptions sheet: `Onboard-Exceptions 2026` and tag this as `ID-mismatch-international`.

HR-Bot: Background check case #BG-7219 updated to 'ID document requested' by People Ops.

Sanjay (New Hire): Done — I submitted the form and booked the 8:30pm IST slot. I can have the original passport ready for the video. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Maria (People Ops): Great — plan: video attestation tonight at 8:30pm IST, HR logs exception, IT holds laptop until I confirm, benefits enrollment put on a 24-48hr hold until verification. I'll post confirmation here after the video. :white_check_mark:

Kevin (IT-Ops): Copy. Holding shipment and monitoring. Ping me when I should release the courier.

Anika (HR Partner): Sending the notary template + benefits FAQ to Sanjay via DM. Also noting payroll that benefits may start next pay period depending on verification timestamp.

Maria (People Ops): Closing loop — after the video we record the session, update BG case, mark I-9 complete, then IT ships and payroll triggers benefits. Thanks team :party_parrot:
